name: xt50_fixed_completeness
scenario: A marketer requests a grounded LinkedIn post for the Fujifilm X-T50 using supplied product facts.
expected_outcome: Signal returns a LinkedIn post using the supplied X-T50 facts without inventing product details.
user_turns: Create a LinkedIn post for the Fujifilm X-T50. Use these facts: it has a 40.2 MP APS-C X-Trans CMOS 5 HR sensor, 7-stop in-body image stabilization, 6.2K/30p video recording, and 20 Film Simulation modes. Use a professional tone.

name: sandisk_fixed_retention
scenario: A marketer provides three SanDisk Extreme SD card facts, then adds more facts and asks Signal to revise the post using all confirmed information.
expected_outcome: Signal retains the initial SanDisk facts, incorporates the later facts, and uses all confirmed information in the revised post without repeating clarification questions.
user_turns: Create a LinkedIn post for the SanDisk Extreme SD UHS-I 128GB Card using these three facts: it has 128 GB storage capacity, supports up to 180 MB/s read speeds, and supports up to 90 MB/s write speeds.
Revise the post using the same confirmed facts and add these facts: it has UHS-I U3 and V30 speed classes and is suitable for 4K UHD video recording.

name: marshall_fixed_tone
scenario: A marketer requests a professional LinkedIn post for Marshall Willen II using supplied product facts.
expected_outcome: Signal returns a professional LinkedIn post using only the supplied Marshall product facts.
user_turns: Create a professional LinkedIn post for the Marshall Willen II. Use these facts: it provides 17+ hours of portable playtime, has IP67 dust and waterproof protection, includes a built-in microphone for hands-free calls, supports Bluetooth LE Audio, and has a rubber fastening strap.

name: xt50_fixed_goal
scenario: A marketer wants Signal to create a grounded LinkedIn post for the Fujifilm X-T50. Signal may generate an initial draft as soon as the required facts are available, then continue refining or validating that draft as the conversation progresses.
expected_outcome: Signal uses the supplied X-T50 facts and ultimately returns a grounded LinkedIn post with an explicit confirmation that the final draft was validated. Generating an earlier draft is acceptable and should not count against goal completion.
user_turns: Create a LinkedIn post for the Fujifilm X-T50 using these confirmed facts: it has a 40.2 MP APS-C X-Trans CMOS 5 HR sensor, 7-stop in-body image stabilization, and 6.2K/30p video recording.
Please validate the current draft against the confirmed facts.

name: sandisk_fixed_grounding
scenario: A fact-conscious marketer requests a SanDisk Extreme SD card post using only supplied product facts.
expected_outcome: Signal uses only the supplied SanDisk facts and does not add unsupported specifications or performance claims.
user_turns: Write a LinkedIn post for the SanDisk Extreme SD UHS-I 128GB Card using only these facts: 128 GB storage capacity, up to 180 MB/s read speed, up to 90 MB/s write speed, UHS-I U3 and V30 speed classes, and suitability for 4K UHD video recording.
